recommendations.claim: Creatine monohydrate 5 g/day has established human-outcome evidence for supporting strength, lean-mass retention, and training recovery, and is well-tolerated at this maintenance dose.
recommendations.source: Large human-outcome literature including ISSN position stand on creatine (2017) and multiple RCT meta-analyses; established-rung human-outcome data for strength/lean-mass/recovery; renal-safety concern in healthy individuals not supported (serum creatinine rise is a measurement artifact, not injury).
recommendations.confidence_tier: maturity_rung: established/monograph-backed; GRADE certainty high, strength conditional (held to conditional because clinician clearance is not granted and this is a pre-liaison draft)
recommendations.reversibility: Fully reversible; muscle creatine stores and any water-retention effect wash out over ~4-6 weeks after discontinuation.

payload.name: creatine monohydrate
payload.timing: any time of day, daily and consistent
